decisions.reason: The dashboard still displays referrals, tickets, and prizes; removing Big Block does not invalidate these generic reward-data categories.
The existing message-195 MODIFY already records the surviving pool's $5 primary-mint contribution and removes the obsolete independence relationship with the Big Block counter.
The existing message-195 MODIFY already removes Big Block references and revises both the primary-mint split and fiat-buyer prize explanation for the surviving $500 prizes.
The existing message-195 MODIFY already replaces the ticket and prize-draw copy with Small Block-only wording, leaving no stale Big Block attribute.
The generic rules that active tickets transfer and expired tickets remain expired continue to apply to surviving Small Block tickets without modification.
The existing message-195 MODIFY fully records the $5 founder allocation, $5 prize-pool allocation, and Small Block as the sole pool recipient.
Removing Big Block does not alter referral badge triggers, milestone thresholds, or the on-chain badge destination.
The NFT mint number remains the permanent referral code and its display locations are unaffected by removal of Big Block.
The source explicitly revises the $15 primary-buy split and does not establish a change to the flat secondary royalty or its founder allocation.
The existing message-195 MODIFY already narrows the notification Requirement's context from Small and Big Block prizes to Small Block only.
The existing message-195 MODIFY already deletes the obsolete big_block_prize_copy while preserving the valid Small Block prize copy.
The source preserves the affiliate allocation at $5, so the existing coded-referral commission amount and delivery rules remain unchanged.
